description: CRIT-202's description claims 'Every REQ-21 pre-publish confirmation criterion (記事タイプ=有料, 価格=NOTE_PRICE, eyecatch present, >=1 visual figure present) is independently checkable, and an UNCONFIRMED state on ANY ONE of them blocks the click with the EXACT missing piece reported.' In the actual implementation, the '>=1 visual figure' refusal branch (lib/note-publish-live.py lines 120-126, the img_count<1 check) is NEVER exercised by any test. tests/test-prop22a-live-publish-wiring.sh's only fixture for this gate (case d) sets eyecatch=None AND img_count=0 simultaneously, so the eyecatch check on line 113 short-circuits and returns False before the img_count check on line 120 is ever reached. There is no fixture with eyecatch SET but zero tags, so the img-count refusal's own exact-reason stderr message ('draft has ZERO tags...') is completely untested code -- for a fail-closed gate on a real, irreversible publish tool, this is a genuine gap between the contract's claimed edge-case coverage and what is actually tested.

corroboratingEvidence.note: stub fixture sets eyecatch: None AND body with 0 tags together, so only the eyecatch branch is ever hit
